summary._about: Experiment 25 (docs/experiments.md). HG = (chance - error) on a heading the readout never saw, divided by (chance - error) on the same frames for a readout trained on the 180 degrees centred on their heading: the share of the seen-heading position information that survives an unseen heading (1 = fully heading-general, 0 = chance, below 0 = worse than chance, e.g. mirrored). Errors are median Euclidean errors in metres over all frames of room A's 48 walks. Per condition: best layer = highest HG among layers whose seen-heading readout beats chance by >= 0.5 m. Calls: positive HG >= 0.5, partial 0.25-0.5, negative < 0.25. equivalent_invariant_share: the share of invariant place units in a synthetic mixture (2,000 units, noise k = 3) with the same HG. unit_invariant_share: the strict unit statistic (experiment 13e) on the same population.
